tooling.message:
feat(interactive): pin app-templates at ea5e798 and describe the slot in the skill

## Intent

The new header and the slot in the interactive heading line should reach apps. Apps and the generator follow app-templates through the commit pinned here, so the pin moves to the merge of app-templates#50, and the skill tells assistants how to use the new runtime (#111).

## Key changes

- The skill lernapps-interactive describes the slot beside the h1 (startInteractive option title), the frame width by --interactive-max-width, and a header that holds only the language switch.
- app-templates is pinned at ea5e798. The header of the interactive and explainer pages holds the language switch and nothing else.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The pin also carries app-templates#46 (explainer practice text, worked tasks, formulas in quiz texts) and #48 (dark mode for quiz and explainer), merged earlier but not yet pinned.
- Needs the runtime change in app-templates (476fda6, 275530a).

moved.why: The pin is the second half of the release asked for here; i179 only asked for the status and gave the go to publish, and has no commits left.
